lines.text: Huh? He quit smoking? So why do I still cough?
We are stuck under this sticky tar, boss.
Then get up and sweep it out!
No way. Our brooms slept for years.
Ugh. Then I keep coughing till you start!
Fine, fine! Brooms up, team, let us go!

events.act: redcell: shoves a smoky rider off its back

lines.text: Whoa! Off my seats, smoky riders!
Hang on, red, we start sweeping today.
Good. I want my oxygen seats back.

events.act: crew: sweepers march past with brooms up

lines.text: Tar is going! The sweepers are awake again!
So that is why the lungs cough so much?
Yep, the boss coughs it all out now!
Doc, I quit. Why more coughing?
Good news: quitting smoking wakes the tiny hairs in your airways.
That cough is your lungs sweeping out old tar after you quit smoking.
Free stop smoking help makes it last, so ask.
A cough lasting weeks? Come and see me.
So, keep coughing and keep going?
